followUps.description: T-2026-0008 closing record is pending in the bids projection
followUps.detail: To make the BUY-19 Close action demonstrable, the bids catalog sets closedAt null for T-2026-0008. Submissions stopped at the 25 Sep 10:00 deadline (status closed) but no closing record exists yet. Monitoring shows 'Deadline passed, closing not recorded' and tebogo.officer can close it. tenders/tenders.ts still has closedAt 2026-09-25T08:00:00Z. The tenders and opening domains should align, or accept closed_at as the closing record time.

followUps.description: Storyline deviation: AC-13 is anchored on T-2026-0008, not T-2026-0002
followUps.detail: T-2026-0002 is open until 21 Oct, so no attempt on it can be late yet. It has 2 suppliers with receipts (Gaborone Metering, Tsodilo) and Serowe approved but not submitted (AC-11). Chobe's T-2026-0002 response is a draft that has not acknowledged addendum 1. Chobe's late replacement (38 s, RCPT-2026-000026) is on T-2026-0008. Recorded in the fixtures/bids/catalog.ts header. docs/plan/demo-storyline.md and reporting/dashboard.ts (which assumes Chobe submitted late on T-2026-0002) should be aligned.

followUps.description: Receipt numbers in the reporting fixtures conflict with the bids receipts
followUps.detail: reporting/dashboard.ts uses RCPT-2026-000024 and RCPT-2026-000026 for receipts other than the bids ones (bids: 000024 = Chobe T-2026-0008 rev 1 effective, 000026 = Chobe T-2026-0008 rev 2 late_rejected, 000025 = Chobe T-2026-0006). followUps.description: Deadline mismatch for T-2026-0002 and T-2026-0011 across domains
followUps.detail: tenders/timetable.ts has T-2026-0002 = 16 Oct and T-2026-0011 = 21 Oct. The bids and clarifications fixtures have 21 Oct (after addendum 1 moved it from 14 Oct) and 23 Oct. The operations incident impact note says 16 Oct. The tenders timetable and operations/incidents.ts impact 11 should follow the addendum-adjusted deadlines.

followUps.description: Service incident INC-2026-007 time window differs between the operations and bids fixtures
followUps.detail: The bids projection now uses the operations title ('Slow document uploads') and severity ('high'). Its window stays 24 Sep 15:20 to 16:05 local (13:20 to 14:05Z), because it covers Gaborone Metering's failed supplement at 13:38 to 13:42Z (AC-12). operations/incidents.ts has 07:40 to 08:25Z and says 'no receipt was affected'. One domain should move its times so the incident and the AC-12 failure coincide.

When integration moves SERVICE_INCIDENT_SEVERITIES into contracts/enums.ts (with an enum label entry 'service_incidents.severity'), update the import in src/contracts/bids/model.ts and fixtures/bids/catalog.ts. The SPA currently labels the severity through submission-monitoring.incidents.severity.*.

Bids contract changes: SubmissionPreview.representative is now nullable (null when the caller lacks supplier.response.submit, FR-11), Receipt gains lateRejection {attemptId, deadlineAtAttempt, lateBySeconds, reason} | null (AC-13), and MonitoringIncident.severity is the ServiceIncidentSeverity enum.
